business.what: Tata Steel manufactures and distributes steel products and related services to customers globally.

metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.reading: Revenue compounded 8% a year over 5 years, -2% over 3 (slowing); last 12 months 11%.

metrics.label: Profit growth
metrics.reading: Profit compounded 8% a year over 5 years, 10% over 3; last 12 months 147%.

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.reading: Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 245% of net profit (strong).

metrics.label: Debt
metrics.reading: Borrowings ₹92,382 cr, 0.90× equity; up from ₹75,561 cr in FY22.

bull.point: Profit growth achieved a strong 147% over the last 12 months.
Cash conversion was very strong, with operating cash flow reaching 245% of net profit over 5 years.

bear.point: Operating margins compressed significantly from 26% in FY22 to 15% in FY26.
ROCE dropped from 31% in FY22 down to 13% in FY26.
Total borrowings increased to ₹92,382 cr, rising from ₹75,561 cr in FY22.
